'''Omnidirectional Sonic Tower''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|<b>Attack Interval</b>: {{Color|5|7}}s
<b>Attack Range</b>: {{Color|6|7}} meters

<b>Mode of Attack</b>: Fires a shockwave that {{Color|stuns|1a}} common and advanced enemies within the area of effect.
|A crowd control facility furnished with a specialized Arts unit. It can emit targeted sonic waves that overwhelm an entity's nervous systems to stun them. The overwhelming power of the sonic waves seem to allow them to disrupt Aggeloid movements.}}
